name: release-notes
description: Automated release-note generation from Jira fix-versions + GitLab/git history. Drafts customer-facing notes and an internal companion doc, publishes to Confluence with smart-merge, and drops a formatted email HTML into a configured folder for stakeholder notification.

drop_folder_root.title: Email drop folder root
drop_folder_root.description: Root path of the OneDrive-synced folder where per-release email.html files are written (your Power Automate flow watches this). Each release gets a subfolder named '{Platform} {Version}'.
